question: What mean Raman shift did the V-O3-V mode near 483 cm^-1 show when the film was prestrained?
rendered: The V-O3-V mode near 483 cm^-1 showed a mean red shift of ∼3.5 cm^-1 when the V2O5 film was prestrained.
